technical_body.meaning: Second digit of NPA opened from {0, 1} to {0-9}. Pre-1995 area codes were N0X or N1X only. Post-1995, codes like 334, 360, 520 appeared.
technical_body.impact: Ended the pre-1995 rule that let phones distinguish area code from prefix by second-digit alone — now 10-digit dialing became necessary in more places.

technical_body.notes: N11 codes are always three digits, never precede an NPA. They are consumed by the local switch's translation table.

technical_body.other_555_XXXX: Allocatable by NANPA for actual services (few in practice; some are used by transportation-info lines).
technical_body.phreak_relevance: 555-1212 was the historic reference number for verifying you had reached a specific NPA — dial NPA-555-1212 from any tandem and hear that NPA's local directory-assistance answer.

800.notes: Original toll-free NPA. Reachable by dialing without a leading 1 in most territories.

technical_body.sms800_meaning: SMS/800 database + RESPORG portability launched. Before this, toll-free numbers were owned by the terminating carrier ('800 number lock-in'). After: any RESPORG could move an 8YY number between carriers.
technical_body.phreak_relevance: Compromised RESPORG credentials meant you could hijack an 8YY number — the era-authentic version of what SS7 STPs later did to SMS termination.

technical_body.meaning: Personal Communication Service (PCS) — 'follow-me' numbers. A single 500-NXX-XXXX number routed to a user's currently-active phone (home, cell, hotel).
technical_body.notes: Mostly a marketing failure; adoption never matched projections.

technical_body.meaning: Canadian non-geographic numbering used for services (call-forwarding aggregation, some paging).
technical_body.notes: Rarely seen from US originations. A US caller dialing 1-600-XXX-XXXX will usually get an intercept unless their IXC has a Canadian gateway.

technical_body.meaning: Feature Group D carrier-specific services. Dialing 1-700-NXX-XXXX reaches the caller's presubscribed IXC's info line for that number.

notable_verification_number.att_response: 'You have reached AT&T Long Distance' or similar
notable_verification_number.purpose: Verify which IXC the calling line is presubscribed to.

technical_body.meaning: Premium (caller-billed) service. Downstream LEC applies a per-minute charge to the caller's bill on behalf of the 900 information provider.
technical_body.phreak_relevance: 900 numbers were a common vector for social-engineering / call-diverting fraud — divert a business PBX to dial a 900 number in a foreign country and profit-share with the 900 operator.

technical_body.meaning: Local premium prefix — NPA-976-XXXX within a single NPA charged per-minute like 900 but stayed within the LEC. Not a national NPA (976 is a prefix within existing NPAs).
technical_body.phreak_relevance: Same fraud vector as 900 but per-NPA. Blocked by many businesses and residential customers via CLASS features.
technical_body.died_because: Superseded by 900 (national) and then by internet-hosted premium services.

technical_body.purpose: Subscriber-dialable carrier-access code. Dial 10XXX (pre-1998) or 101XXXX (post-1998) before 1+NPA+NXX+XXXX to route the call over a specific IXC's network, bypassing the caller's presubscribed carrier.
technical_body.phreak_relevance: 10-XXX dialaround was heavily marketed for consumer 'flat-rate' dialing during the 1996-2003 era. Sometimes used to bypass toll restrictions on a hotel PBX by dialing 101-XXXX-1-NPA-NXX-XXXX where the hotel had only blocked '1-'-prefixed dialing.

name: Feature Groups A / B / C / D (carrier access)

FGA.meaning: Local dial-up to an alternate long-distance carrier via a 7-digit local number. Pre-divestiture; largely obsolete post-1984.

FGC.meaning: Access for AT&T's presubscribed customers (pre-divestiture routing). Historical.

FGD.meaning: Full equal-access — 10XXX/101XXXX CIC dialaround, ANI II delivery, presubscription. The dominant post-1984 format.

technical_body.purpose: Subscriber-dialable Feature Group B access. Dial 950-XXXX to reach an alternate long-distance carrier's Point of Presence (POP) at no local charge.
technical_body.post_connect: Carrier tone (typically a beep or short prompt); enter card number + destination.
technical_body.died_because: 10XXX / 101XXXX dialaround (FGD) generalized carrier-selection and largely displaced 950-XXXX by 2000.

name: LATA structure (Local Access and Transport Area)

technical_body.purpose: Post-divestiture (1984) geographic-and-regulatory zone. Calls within a LATA were LEC (local exchange carrier) territory; calls between LATAs required an IXC (inter-exchange carrier) to bridge.
technical_body.count: Approximately 200 LATAs in the US at divestiture.
technical_body.phreak_relevance: LATA boundaries defined where the 'presubscribed carrier' choice mattered. In-LATA calls were free (or LEC-billed); inter-LATA calls were IXC-billed and thus the dial-around fraud target.
technical_body.died_because: Slowly obsoleting since the Telecommunications Act of 1996 opened LATA boundaries; still a concept in tariffs but less operationally meaningful.
